purpose: Decisive zero-training test of the churn hypothesis: does the best confirmed development actor (V1.1 U2, 15/353 on the development panel) retain any improvement over paired BC on a start-point panel it was never selected on?

hypotheses.H_churn: The development-panel improvement (21->15 collision, 346->353 overtake) is a selection artifact (order statistic of ~46 checkpoint evaluations with sd ~3). Prediction: on the held-out panel the candidate is indistinguishable from paired BC.
hypotheses.H_real: The candidate carries a genuine collision reduction that transfers. Prediction: the candidate reproduces a collision reduction of comparable direction and size on the held-out panel.

held_out_panel.name: austin_600_holdout33
held_out_panel.definition: Identical to the fixed development panel generator (evaluate.sh) except every ego start index is shifted by EGO_IDX_OFFSET=33: ego_idx = floor(i*2096/49) + 33 for i in 0..49 (effective index modulo 2097 applied inside eval_multiagent).

separation.note: No holdout start index coincides exactly with any development or training start index. A uniform offset cannot be far from both panels simultaneously because the two existing panels interleave at ~21-waypoint half-spacing. Independence from the DEVELOPMENT panel (the selection surface) is the property this test requires; residual proximity to TRAINING startpoints can only favor the candidate, so a null result remains conservative evidence for H_churn.

execution_contract.command: MODEL_PATH=<copy> EGO_IDX_OFFSET=33 COLLISION_SCOPE=ego RENDER=false SAVE_TRACE=false NOISE=0.0 NUM_WORKERS=8 bash evaluate.sh
execution_contract.attempts: Exactly one evaluation per model. A rerun is permitted only if the attempt is INVALID (error > 0 or total != 600) and the failure cause is infrastructural; any such rerun must be recorded with the failed attempt retained.
execution_contract.single_use: This held-out panel is single-use for the V1.x line. Neither device may evaluate any other V1.x checkpoint on it afterwards; it must not become a second selection surface. The one-shot discipline is global across devices, not per device.

preregistered_decision_rule.valid: error == 0 and ego_collision + follow + overtake == 600 for both runs
preregistered_decision_rule.real_improvement_confirmed: candidate_ego_collision <= bc_ego_collision - 4 AND candidate_overtake >= ceil(0.95 * bc_overtake)
preregistered_decision_rule.otherwise: CONSISTENT_WITH_CHURN: the development-panel best is declared a selection artifact; the V1.x micro-LR hyperparameter line is closed as the final conclusion of this round. No post-hoc threshold adjustment.
preregistered_decision_rule.margin_justification: The claimed development effect is -6 collisions; observed checkpoint-to-checkpoint churn sd is 3.05; requiring at least -4 demands the transferred effect exceed ~1.3 churn sd in the claimed direction while tolerating panel-difficulty shift. The overtake floor mirrors the existing G2 gate ratio (0.95 of paired BC).

context.concurrent_runs_note: Three ALS-final training runs (seeds 20260715/16/17, 16 updates) were already running on device A when this record was created (started 2026-07-17 12:00 local). They are independent processes; evaluation determinism does not depend on machine load. Their existence contradicts the decide-before-training ordering this test was requested to establish, and is flagged in the session report.
